content: The description of turning the printer could be a bit clearer. I put the printer on it's side with the left side facing up, but now I'm realizing that I was probably only supposed to spin it 90 degrees on its base (or in my case, just walk to the other side of it since it's on a corner).

replies.content: Also while it was on its side an M3 nut fell out, so hopefully that wasn't doing anything important...

content: again this screw called for a t10
Rather than only releasing the five cable straps, I recommend rewording this to "Remove the five cable straps".
I would remove the two "smokey" plastic top side panels during this step. I had an easier time with unscrewing things on the nextruder.
